title: Stylish 2 Bd/2.5 Ba Townhome
description:
Enjoy your stay in this centrally located townhome minutes from Nashville's International Airport and Music City's famous downtown attractions. This spacious 2 BR/2.5 BA offers all the comforts of home. Complete with a full kitchen, firepit, laundry appliances and free designated parking on the premises. This unit offers a queen bed in the master and in the guest bedroom.

The space
Proximity easily accessible by car and rideshares (Lyft, Uber):

* 10 mins to Nashville's International Airport (BNA)
* 15-20 mins to downtown
* 2 mins to neighborhood grocery stores (Kroger/Aldi)
* 5 mins to Percy Priest Lake

The half bath is on the main floor and both bedrooms have access to their own full baths. Please treat this space as if it was your own home.

Guest access
You will have the entire space, except the master closet as I do occupy the space at times when not booked. There is a hanging rod for your clothes on the door of the master closet, and  a walk in closet in the guest room. I hope you enjoy your stay and please reach out to me with any questions.
